exposure: abnormal blood vessels in the placental bed
prophylactic balloon occlusion of the internal iliac artery (PBOIIA)
cohort: 46 patients diagnosed with PAS and placenta previa who underwent PBOIIA during cesarean section
finding: The presence of T2 dark bands and placental bulge on MRI can predict adverse maternal outcomes in patients with PAS and placenta previa undergoing PBOIIA.
